ios.desc:
Wooby is a weight and habit tracker that feels nothing like a weight and habit tracker.

Instead of cold charts, numbers, and "you're behind" warnings, Wooby gives you a cute little companion to care for. When you log your weight or check off a habit, you're feeding and bonding with your pet — turning everyday self-care into something warm, gentle, and genuinely delightful.

No shame. No pressure. No punishment for a number going the "wrong" way. Just showing up for yourself, one cozy day at a time.

HOW IT WORKS
- Adopt a pet and bring it home.
- Log your weight or complete a habit — that's how you care for your companion.
- Earn treats, discover rare furniture, and decorate a little room that's all your own.
- Come back tomorrow. Your pet will be happy to see you.

WHY WOOBY IS DIFFERENT
- Gentle by design. Your pet droops when neglected but always recovers — it never dies, never guilts you, and never treats a hard day as a failure.
- Celebrates showing up, not the scale. Consistency is the win; a weight that went up is never a "bad" state.
- A world you build. Feed your pet, grow your bond, and fill your room with decor you've earned.
- Alive and playful. Pet your companion, watch it react with delight, and catch it playing when you drop in.
- More than weight. Track water, sleep, movement, a junk-food-free day, or any habit you choose.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your data stays on your phone. Wooby has no accounts and no servers, collects nothing, and uses no ads or tracking. If you like, you can save your weight to Apple Health with one tap — Wooby only ever writes it, and never reads your Health data.

Wooby is for anyone who wants to build healthier habits without the cold, clinical, guilt-trip energy of typical trackers. If aggressive fitness apps make you want to close the app and never open it again, Wooby is for you.

Adopt your companion and start your cozy streak today.

quotes.text: My girlfriend hated all the weight tracking apps out there because they felt really analytical and cold. So I figured I'd make a cute gamified weight tracker for her! Introducing Wooby! You can choose one of four pets to raise, and log your behaviors and watch your pet get happier. It gives you motivational messages as you log your weight and habits, and you can unlock furniture and decorate your pet's home as well. You can even play with your pet. It's totally free right now and we don't collect any data either so give it a try!
